# Gitdog - AI GitHub Assistant

> AI-powered assistant for GitHub repositories. Automates issue responses and discussion replies with intelligent codebase-aware answers.

## About Gitdog

Gitdog is an AI automation platform for GitHub that helps developers automate repetitive tasks. When users mention @gitdogbot in issues or discussions, the AI assistant analyzes the codebase context and provides intelligent, relevant responses.

## Core Features

- **Issue Automation**: AI responds to issues with codebase-aware answers
- **Discussion Assistant**: Intelligent replies in GitHub Discussions
- **Context-Aware Answers**: Repository-specific guidance grounded in indexed code
- **Codebase Indexing**: Full repository understanding for accurate responses

## Pricing

- **Free Plan**: $0/month - 100,000 tokens/month with a hard limit; prepaid token packs are available for additional usage
- **Pro Plan**: $9.99/month - 2.4M tokens/month; prepaid token packs are available for additional usage, with no automatic overage charges

## Technical Details

- Platform: Web application (SaaS)
- Integration: GitHub App
- Languages Supported: All programming languages
- Authentication: GitHub OAuth
